normalized.description: The object of the procurement is newsroom analytics solutions to enable near real-time article and video analytics in Yle’s digital services. The primary function of this solution is to provide our editorial teams with near real-time data and analysis of article performance on the yle.fi website and the Yle mobile application. The goal is to empower our newsroom and other editorial staff with actionable insights to make data-driven editorial decisions. The object of the procurement is described in detail in the Invitation to Tender and its annexes: Appendix 1 Object of the Procurement Newsroom Real-time Analytics Solution Appendix 2 Requirements Newsroom Real-time Analytics Solution Appendix 3 Pricing Appendix 4 Use Cases for Scoring Appendix 5 SaaS Subscription Agreement Appendix 5.1 Data protection agreement Appendix 5.2 JIT 2025 – Services over Network Appendix 5.3 JIT 2025 – General Terms and Conditions Appendix 6 Reference requirements Appendix 7 Evaluation of tenders Appendix Subcontractors Yle will choose one (1) supplier as a contracting party as a result of this bidding competition. Title: Finland – Unmanned aerial vehicles – Revised Aerial drone fleet with docking station
Procedure title: Revised Aerial drone fleet with docking station
Description: The contracting authorities intends to jointly buy: Aerial drone fleet with data loading and recharging docking station (unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)) with the following mandatory minimum requirements: - with take-off weight less than 25 kg. Total weight not exceeding 25 kg, payload capacity more than 2 kg (payload must be interchangeable e.g., RGB, spectral cameras, lidar). Therefore, these kinds of instrumentations should be able to attach onto the drone. - the maximum weight of the offered docking station is 140 kg - Flight time with maximum payload should be at least 30 min - Minimum flight speed of the drone should be 3 m/s or less. Capability also to fly with up to 8 m/s or more. - Safety systems for landing (e.g. parachute) - System should be fully electric - Drone and its sensors should fit onto docking station - Operation wind conditions, up to 12 m/s wind speed - Size of the system: under 3 meters in diameter, transport less than size 2 m in diameter - A water proof (IP44 minimum, recommended IP55) drone and drone platform for outdoor use. - Minimum 4G connection with automatic data transfer to cloud service or similar. - Costs of the maintenance and maintenance program (done by user or company) should be specified. (user maintenance preferred) - Operating Temperature range at least -10 to 40C, - The drone should be equipped with a location positioning system (GNSS: GPS+GLONASS+BeiDou+Galileo). Options for RTK and VRS functions are required. - Battery swap and/or charge so that downtime maximum is 60 minutes. - radio control range up to 7 km from docking station - Applications: Remote control software. Cloud Platform support (EU based), can be own cloud or a support of 3rd Party Platforms through API or similar - Drone must be able to autonomously take off and land from the docking station. The docking station automatically opens and closes to fully enclose the drone. The docking station automatically charges the drone. This pocurement includes mandatory options. Mandatory options must be offered and are: - Maintenance program, costs of the maintenance and maintenance program (done by user or company) should be specified. (user maintenance preferred) - Options for RTK and VRS functions - The second Aerial drone fleet with data loading and recharging docking station, at the same price and terms as the first offered Aerial drone fleet with data loading and recharging docking station. The use of options is at the sole discretion of the Buyers. Options are not used in price comparison or in quality evaluations so a tenderer should not include these prices into the total comparison price but inform prices in a separate appendix.
